summary: Feed c044_link to NDR is degraded: 1.10% packet loss (1,928,460/1,950,000 received) on link LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 (SPAN destination) -> VF-1 port 3 exceeds 0.1% threshold by 11x. Link error counters healthy, indicating loss on the interconnect (cable/optic/unmonitored device).

findings.root_cause: Physical/interconnect loss between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 SPAN destination and VF-1 port 3 input: SPAN sent 1,950,000 packets but broker input saw only 1,928,460 (21,540 packets / 1.10% lost). Link error check is healthy, so loss is not reported as FCS/error counters but as missing packets on the wire - typical of faulty optic/cable, dirty fiber, marginal transceiver, or an unmonitored device/patch panel in between.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR requires complete bidirectional traffic with full payload for TCP reassembly and detection. 1.10% random loss breaks flows, causes incomplete sessions, missed signatures/anomalies and false negatives, well above 0.001 threshold for reliable detection.

recommended_fix.why: Fix physical path loss first - NDR cannot achieve coverage with 1% missing traffic. Inspect/replace optics and cable between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 and VF-1 port 3, check patch panels, clean fiber, verify SPAN destination oversubscription and link speed/duplex, then re-verify packet counts match.
